## 2. Detailed Description of the Data
The dataset consits of retail sales transactions of 21 columns.
Row ID (integer)
Order ID (string)
Order Date (Date)
Ship Date (Date)
Ship (Categorical)
Customer ID (string)
Customer Name (string)
Segment (Categorical)
Country (Categorical)
City (Categorical)
State (Categorical)
Postal Code (Numeric)
Region (Categorical)
Product ID (string)
category (Categorical)
Sub-Category (Categorical)
Product Name (string)
Sales (Continuous Numeric)
Quantity (integer)

## 3.Data Methodology Collection
The data set is merged retail sales from four US regions: WEST, CENTRAL, SOUTH, and EAST. Synthetically, it stored in Kaggle platform over time.

## 4. Why does this data set intrigue you?
I want to understand this retail sales and profit trends, and how discount strategy will be beneficial from business perspective, using R language.
